Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: In frames 8 through 12, when the board is fully or mostly visible, exactly three pens are present in a row.
In frames 7-12, all three pens are oriented with their caps pointing downwards (towards the bottom of the frame).
In frames 7-12, the leftmost pen has a blue barrel and cap, while the middle and rightmost pens have black caps and clear/dark barrels. They are not all the same color.
All visible pens appear to have their caps on; no bare writing tips are exposed.
The board translates smoothly from left to right across the sequence of frames without visible stopping or reversing.
The relative positions of the pens on the board remain constant throughout the visible duration.

parsed.reason: The video shows three pens on the board, but one pen is blue while the other two are black/clear, violating the requirement that all pens be identical in color.

description: One pen differs in color from the other two.
